---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the framework (.kenovis/AI/, CLAUDE.md, README) is broken, contradictory, or doesn't work as documented
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## What's broken

A clear description of the problem.

## Where

Which file(s) — e.g. `.kenovis/AI/agents/backend.md`, `.kenovis/AI/policies/database.md`.

## Expected vs actual

What the documented behavior/instruction says should happen, vs what actually happens when an AI tool follows it.

## AI tool used

Claude Code / other (name it) — framework is meant to be tool-agnostic per [DECISION-010](../../DECISIONS.md), so cross-tool bugs matter most.

## Additional context

Anything else — logs, transcript excerpts, links.
